applies_to: Berner air curtains fitted with the Berner AIR BMS package on the IntelliSwitch control (software 3.00, firmware 1.46), including the Architectural Elite AE08-F and AE10-F.
summary: The Berner AIR BMS package makes the IntelliSwitch air curtain control a BACnet application specific controller (B-ASC) on BACnet MS/TP or BACnet IP (wired or wireless). Besides mode, fan speed, time delay and door status it adds a BMS mode in which the BMS calls for fan and heat directly, a heater disable and a heater cool-down delay. Heated models add a setpoint and door temperature in °F and °C.
notes: From the PICS dated 26 March 2025 (footer Rev. December 2024; file name 3.1.0212); each object's present value is marked RO or RW.
Berner's earlier PICS for the Architectural Elite AE08-F / AE10-F (same software 3.00 / firmware 1.46) lists a subset: no BMS mode state, CallForFan, CallForHeat, HeaterDisabled or Cool Down Delay.
The Network Port object (type 56) is listed as Other 1; it is named Serial in MS/TP mode and Wired or Wireless in IP mode.
The summary table spells PIV 4 as CoolDownDelay; the object block gives the name Cool Down Delay.
AV 1-2, AI 1-2, PIV 4, BV 2 and BV 3 apply to heated models only.

source.title: Berner AIR BMS BACnet PICS (for Berner air curtains with the Berner AIR BMS package)

integration.summary: Either write MV 1 Mode to Off/On/Auto/Comfort+ and let the curtain run itself, or set Mode to 5 (BMS) and drive it with BV 1 CallForFan and, on heated models, BV 2 CallForHeat. Set PIV 2 FanSpeed and the AV 1 (°F) or AV 2 (°C) setpoint, and read BI 1 DoorStatus and the door temperature.

minimum_points.name: Mode
minimum_points.why: Mode: 1 off, 2 on, 3 auto, 4 Comfort+, 5 BMS

minimum_points.name: CallForFan
minimum_points.why: Fan run command in BMS mode

minimum_points.name: CallForHeat
minimum_points.why: Heat command in BMS mode (heated models)

integration.enable: MV 1 Mode = 5 (BMS) hands the fan and heater to BV 1 CallForFan and BV 2 CallForHeat. BV 3 HeaterDisabled turns the heater off completely.
setup: MS/TP: MAC address 0-127, max master and max info frames are set in the Network Port object (Serial).
IP: wired or wireless is chosen on the touchscreen or the mobile app; UDP port 47808 by default; foreign device registration with a BBMD address and a default lifetime of 30.
gotchas: MV 1 reports Out_Of_Service = true while the emergency stop is active.
CallForFan and CallForHeat only act when Mode is BMS.
AV 1 (°F) and AV 2 (°C) are both the temperature setpoint; map the one in your BMS units.
